question: What would the initiative change for someone who receives an AHV old-age pension?

claims.text: The initiative would provide AHV old-age pension recipients with an additional annual payment equal to one twelfth of their annual pension, effectively adding a 13th pension payment each year.

The government estimated that implementing this initiative would increase AHV spending by approximately CHF 4.1 billion per year, with costs rising to around CHF 5 billion five years after introduction.

citations.text: Die Initiative fordert, dass die monatliche Rente nicht nur 12 Mal, sondern 13 Mal pro Jahr ausbezahlt wird.
Zu den 12 Monatsrenten käme jedes Jahr eine 13. Rente dazu.
